create_boundarybox_from_min_max: create a BoundaryBox from min and max numpy arrays defining spatial bounds
parse_boundarybox_from_string: parse a BoundaryBox from a comma-separated string of min and max coordinate values
normalize_coordinates_with_boundarybox: normalize coordinates to a 0-1 range using a BoundaryBox min and max bounds
project_geocoordinates_to_topocentric: project latitude longitude coordinates to topocentric XY using a Projection instance
unproject_topocentric_to_geocoordinates: unproject topocentric XY coordinates back to latitude longitude using a Projection instance
